liza.note: This is the previously selected female reference voice. Never label a Piper/system fallback as Liza.

irina.note: Free alternative only when Tumsoev explicitly selects Irina. Do not use a system voice and call it Irina.

rules: For NOVA Studio Explainer, use Liza by default because that is the reference-video voice profile.
If Liza exact provider is unavailable, stop and report that exact Liza is unavailable; do not silently switch voices.
If Tumsoev explicitly selects Irina, use real Piper ru_RU-irina-medium only.
Never route an explicitly selected iPhone/Mac/system Russian voice through Piper.
No paid TTS call or provider usage without explicit approval after cost is shown.
Keep narration as one continuous phrase or a small number of long chunks to avoid clicks and chopped pauses.
Normalize final speech to approximately -16 to -17 LUFS, true peak <= -2 dBTP, add 5-15 ms microfades at edits, and avoid inserted pauses longer than needed.
